cards.front: Complete the rule: A mechanically unsafe vehicle must…
cards.back: A mechanically unsafe vehicle must not be driven in Idaho.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The driver is responsible for correcting dangerous…
cards.back: The driver is responsible for correcting dangerous defects, missing essential equipment or necessary vehicle repairs.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle must have two independent brake systems…
cards.back: A vehicle must have two independent brake systems so one remains usable if the other fails.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On dry pavement, the foot brake must stop…
cards.back: On dry pavement, the foot brake must stop a vehicle traveling twenty miles an hour within twenty-five feet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At twenty miles an hour on dry pavement…
cards.back: At twenty miles an hour on dry pavement, the emergency or parking brake must stop the vehicle within fifty-five feet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The parking brake must keep a…
cards.back: The parking brake must keep a parked vehicle from moving on a hill.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle needs two headlamps…
cards.back: A vehicle needs two headlamps providing both high and low beams.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Headlamps must illuminate the…
cards.back: Headlamps must illuminate the road without dazzling approaching drivers.

cards.front: Complete the rule: High beams must make people and vehicles…
cards.back: High beams must make people and vehicles visible at least three hundred fifty feet ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Low beams must illuminate at least…
cards.back: Low beams must illuminate at least one hundred feet of roadway ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Headlights must not be covered with…
cards.back: Headlights must not be covered with material that is reflective, opaque or non-transparent.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A motor vehicle’s working brake lights must be…
cards.back: A motor vehicle’s working brake lights must be red or amber and visible at least one hundred feet behind in normal sunlight.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Brake lights must illuminate when…
cards.back: Brake lights must illuminate when the foot brake is applied.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle built before January first, nineteen…
cards.back: A vehicle built before January first, nineteen fifty-six needs at least one red rear light.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Except for vehicles built before January first, nineteen…
cards.back: Except for vehicles built before January first, nineteen fifty-six, a passenger motor vehicle needs two red rear lights, one on each side, visible from five hundred feet behind.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A motor vehicle built after January first, nineteen…
cards.back: A motor vehicle built after January first, nineteen fifty-five needs driver-controlled flashing electric signals for both left and right turns at front and rear, visible from one hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a motor vehicle built after January first…
cards.back: On a motor vehicle built after January first, nineteen fifty-five, the front electric turn signals must be white or amber.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a motor vehicle built after January first…
cards.back: On a motor vehicle built after January first, nineteen fifty-five, the rear electric turn signals must be red or amber.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Each tire should retain at least…
cards.back: Each tire should retain at least two thirty-seconds of an inch of tread.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A motor vehicle must have a horn…
cards.back: A motor vehicle must have a horn audible from at least two hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A horn producing an unreasonably…
cards.back: A horn producing an unreasonably loud or harsh sound is prohibited.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Vehicle windows and windshields…
cards.back: Vehicle windows and windshields must use approved safety glass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Damaged window or windshield glass must be…
cards.back: Damaged window or windshield glass must be replaced when it obstructs the driver’s view.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Windows and windshields must remain free of signs…
cards.back: Windows and windshields must remain free of signs and stickers other than those required by law.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Objects placed or hung inside the vehicle…
cards.back: Objects placed or hung inside the vehicle must not block the windows or windshield.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Frost, snow, dirt and other visibility…
cards.back: Frost, snow, dirt and other visibility obstructions must be removed from vehicle glass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Window and windshield treatments must not create a…
cards.back: Window and windshield treatments must not create a mirrored surface or otherwise make the glass difficult to see through, even from outside.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Every motor vehicle needs windshield wipers…
cards.back: Every motor vehicle needs windshield wipers that remove rain, snow and other moisture.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A motor vehicle’s rear-view mirror must provide a…
cards.back: A motor vehicle’s rear-view mirror must provide a highway view extending at least two hundred feet behind.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When a load or trailer blocks the usual…
cards.back: When a load or trailer blocks the usual view through the rear window, the vehicle needs an additional mirror on each side.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle without a rear-view mirror needs…
cards.back: A vehicle without a rear-view mirror needs both a left and a right side mirror.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Children aged six or younger traveling in a…
cards.back: Children aged six or younger traveling in a non-commercial vehicle must use approved child safety seats under the law applicable to cars built with safety belts after January first, nineteen sixty-six.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A child safety seat…
cards.back: A child safety seat must meet federal safety standards.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The child must fit snugly…
cards.back: The child must fit snugly within the safety seat’s own straps.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The child safety seat must…
cards.back: The child safety seat must be secured to the vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The child safety seat must…
cards.back: The child safety seat must be used on every trip.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook recommends reading both the child-seat instructions…
cards.back: The handbook recommends reading both the child-seat instructions and the vehicle manual for height and weight limits and correct installation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook recommends the rear seat…
cards.back: The handbook recommends the rear seat for every child younger than thirteen.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook’s safety recommendations say never to place…
cards.back: The handbook’s safety recommendations say never to place a rear-facing child seat in front of an active passenger airbag.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Idaho requires occupants to wear whichever safety belts…
cards.back: Idaho requires occupants to wear whichever safety belts and shoulder straps were supplied for them as factory equipment in the motor vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Headlamps and taillamps must be…
cards.back: Headlamps and taillamps must be on between sunset and sunrise.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Poor visibility also requires headlamps…
cards.back: Poor visibility also requires headlamps and taillamps when needed for safety.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver must dim headlights five…
cards.back: A driver must dim headlights five hundred feet before meeting another vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver must dim headlights two…
cards.back: A driver must dim headlights two hundred feet before overtaking another vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When driving requires lights, the driver…
cards.back: When driving requires lights, the driver must use headlights rather than parking lights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passengers and cargo must not block the…
cards.back: Passengers and cargo must not block the driver’s view or interfere with vehicle operation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: By day, a load extending at least four…
cards.back: By day, a load extending at least four feet behind the vehicle must carry a red flag at its far end.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The flag on a load projecting at least…
cards.back: The flag on a load projecting at least four feet behind must be at least eighteen inches square.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At night, a load projecting at least four…
cards.back: At night, a load projecting at least four feet behind needs a red light visible from at least five hundred feet in place of the flag.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle’s load must not…
cards.back: A vehicle’s load must not project beyond the left fenders.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle’s load may extend no more…
cards.back: A vehicle’s load may extend no more than six inches beyond the right fenders.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reckless driving with willful disregard for people or…
cards.back: Reckless driving with willful disregard for people or property is prohibited on both public roads and private property.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver must give full…
cards.back: A driver must give full attention to operating the vehicle safely.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Failure to attend to safe vehicle…
cards.back: Failure to attend to safe vehicle operation can result in an inattentive-driving citation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook directs readers to the child-seat and…
cards.back: The handbook directs readers to the child-seat and vehicle instructions for installation using a seat belt or the LATCH system.

cards.front: Complete the rule: LATCH means Lower Anchors…
cards.back: LATCH means Lower Anchors and Tethers for Children.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook notes that ITD sometimes…
cards.back: The handbook notes that ITD sometimes changes studded-tire season dates because of weather.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Operating another person’s vehicle without consent while intending…
cards.back: Operating another person’s vehicle without consent while intending only to deprive the owner temporarily, rather than steal it, is a misdemeanor.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Idaho does not require…
cards.back: Idaho does not require a yearly vehicle safety inspection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: An officer who stops a vehicle and finds…
cards.back: An officer who stops a vehicle and finds unsafe conditions or missing required equipment may issue a citation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Brake-light lenses should…
cards.back: Brake-light lenses should be kept clean.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A motor vehicle must have a working…
cards.back: A motor vehicle must have a working muffler that prevents unusual or loud noise.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Motor vehicles and trailers need fenders, wheel covers…
cards.back: Motor vehicles and trailers need fenders, wheel covers or flaps that prevent wheel-thrown material from reaching other vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A trailer or semitrailer built on or after…
cards.back: A trailer or semitrailer built on or after January first, nineteen fifty-six needs at least two red rear lamps, one on each side, visible from five hundred feet behind.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Safety belts help the driver keep control on…
cards.back: Safety belts help the driver keep control on winding or rough roads and during collision-avoidance maneuvers.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Red and blue emergency lights…
cards.back: Red and blue emergency lights are permitted only on emergency vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Sirens, bells and whistles are listed…
cards.back: Sirens, bells and whistles are listed as prohibited equipment for ordinary vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A muffler cutout or bypass…
cards.back: A muffler cutout or bypass that increases exhaust noise is prohibited.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle must not…
cards.back: A vehicle must not have more than two spotlights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle must not have…
cards.back: A vehicle must not have more than two front auxiliary lights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle must not have…
cards.back: A vehicle must not have more than two front fog lights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle must not have more…
cards.back: A vehicle must not have more than two cowl or fender lights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before driving, the driver must clear ice, snow…
cards.back: Before driving, the driver must clear ice, snow and dirt from the windows to preserve visibility in every direction.
